datasets.name: Planetary interior-structure layers for the cutaway view (18 bodies)
datasets.organization: Published literature (seismology, gravity and geodesy papers); curated by the Cosmos project
datasets.purpose: Layer radii, composition and 'how we know' evidence for the interiors cutaway (src/ui/interiors)
datasets.mechanism: Hand-curated from the cited literature in scripts/data/interiors/source.mjs; scripts/data/interiors/build.mjs adds radius fractions from public/data/solar/bodies.json and writes the JSON; no network access
datasets.version: schemaVersion 1; generated 2026-10-20; 50 references (e.g. PREM, Dziewonski & Anderson 1981; Stahler et al. 2021; Militzer et al. 2022)
datasets.license: Facts and model values transcribed from published papers; no third-party text or figures are redistributed. Individual papers keep their own licences. Not recorded: per-paper licence terms.
datasets.citation: See the 'references' object in interiors.json (each entry has a citation and DOI), e.g. Dziewonski & Anderson 1981, Phys. Earth Planet. Inter. 25, 297 (PREM); Anzellini et al. 2013, Science 340, 464; Weber et al. 2011, Science 331, 309; Stahler et al. 2021, Science 373, 443; Wahl et al. 2017, GRL 44, 4649; Militzer et al. 2022, PSJ 3, 185; Bahcall et al. 2005, ApJ 621, L85.
datasets.rateLimits: n/a (no network access; static transcription from papers)
datasets.updateCadence: manual; revisit when new seismic or gravity results change a body's accepted structure
datasets.normalization: Layer outer radii (km) from the source tables; fraction = outerKm / mean radius from public/data/solar/bodies.json; outerRangeKm / fractionRange give the spread of published models, not formal error bars; build.mjs fails if radii are not increasing, a source is unknown, or the outer layer differs from the body radius by more than 0.1%.
datasets.fallback: The interiors view is unavailable for a body whose entry is missing.
datasets.limitations: Temperatures inside every body are model estimates except Earth's inner-core boundary (iron melting experiments) and the Sun's photosphere (observed). Layers flagged model: true depend on an interior model rather than a direct measurement. Per the file notes, provenance is observed (seismology, helioseismology), derived (gravity, moment of inertia, induction) or model-dependent.
